## Included with every Polestar 2

- 3 years vehicle, 8 years battery, and 12 years corrosion warranty












Polestar includes comprehensive warranties with every Polestar car:







  - Vehicle warranty: covers any parts that fail due to manufacturing defects with free repairs or replacements at an authorised Polestar service point. This guarantee covers the first 3 years after delivery, regardless of a change in ownership, or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first, regardless of a change in ownership.

  - Battery warranty: covers any faults in battery performance or defects in material and workmanship will be resolved free of charge, within 8 years or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. If the battery’s State-of-Health drops below 70% of its original capacity within the first 8 years of ownership or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first, the battery will be repaired or replaced at no cost.

  - Corrosion warranty: covers the repair or replacement of affected bodywork perforated by corrosion at an authorised Polestar service point, free of charge. Coverage lasts for the first 12 years after delivery, regardless of a change in ownership, with possible regional variations.


[Read more about warranty](https://www.polestar.com/uk/support/faq/warranty/)

- Free Roadside assistance for 3 years












Every new Polestar comes with 3 years of free roadside assistance. Pressing the connect button in the overhead console will guarantee 24/7 support, including car recovery, alternative transport, and arranging an overnight stay if necessary.

- Over-the-air updates and 1 year of free connected services plus












Regular over-the-air updates are included, enhancing the car's features and systems without the need to visit a workshop. 1 year of connected services plus is also included, enabling web browsing, app use, music streaming, and real-time traffic updates. Drivers can renew this service once the complementary period expires.









[Explore connected services](https://www.polestar.com/uk/owning-a-polestar/connected-services/)

- Polestar Charge












Polestar Charge is a service for Polestar drivers that gathers the largest charging networks in Europe into one app. It provides access to over 1,000,000 charging stations without the need for multiple profiles or payment solutions.









[Explore Polestar Charge](https://www.polestar.com/uk/charging/charging-network)

1. Range figure based on the Long range Single motor and WLTP standard. Electric vehicles sold in the UK are measured against a standardized metric for range. The Worldwide Harmonized Light Vehicle Test Procedure (WLTP) measures the range of a car travelling at an average speed of 48 km/h / 30 mph  in summer temperatures from a 100% to 0% state of charge. The actual range achieved under real conditions varies depending on driving behaviour and other external factors. Therefore, the certified WLTP range isn't usually achievable in real life.

2. Performance figures based on the Polestar 2 Long range Dual motor with Performance pack. Energy consumption for Polestar 2 Long range Dual motor with Performance pack:  27.0 - 27.2 kWh/100 mi.

3. Google, Android, Android Automotive, Gemini, and other marks are trademarks of Google LLC. Compatible Android phone and compatible active data plan required for Android Automotive. Features may differ depending on subscription, and results may vary. Some connected apps require setup. Compatibility and availability vary. 18+. Not all services, features, applications, or required compatible devices are available in all languages or countries, and may vary by car model.
